## Spinner.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `form` :: The visual style of the spinner.
- `size` :: The size of the spinner.
- `tone` :: The colour of the spinner.
- `label` :: A visually hidden label, announced to assistive technology. Defaults to "Loading".
